origin.description: Run code with a package namespace name on the search path.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the namespace name is attached.

origin.details: The name is detached after code. The package itself stays loaded.
origin.example:
name <- format(asNamespace("stats"))
during <- with_namespace("stats", name %in% search())
c(if (isTRUE(during)) "TRUE" else "FALSE", if (name %in% search()) "attached" else "detached")

translation.description: Run code with a package namespace name on the search path.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the namespace name is attached.

translation.details: The name is detached after code. The package itself stays loaded. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

name = "<environment: namespace:stats>"
during = with_namespace("stats", lambda: name in search())
flag = "attached" if name in search() else "detached"
return ["TRUE" if during else "FALSE", flag]
